{{Quote|His name's Thark. He's a rude, obnoxious Aqualish&mdash;not to be redundant&mdash;and he's a menace to free people in this town.|Bren Kingal|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Thark''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was killed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], fooled by [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] citizen [[Bren Kingal]] into believing that Thark was a crook.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TharkFemale.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Non-canon female representation of Thark]]
Thark was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older [[:w:c:swg:Quest|quests]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the appearance of Thark changed each time a player performed this quest. Under his spawn template, he would appear as a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned, brown-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] Aqualish, either male or female. The quest dialogue given by Bren Kingal established Thark as a male. Although not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining him revealed him to be a [[Scout/Legends|scout]]. However, this was primarily due to game mechanics, as a result of Thark being placed under the randomized Aqualish scout spawn template appearance.
